Implemented the Cargo project in [Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) and [main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It uses only the Rust standard library and includes G-code execution, tool and parameter files, probing, block deletion, JSON results, and optional motion traces.

The release build succeeds with `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`.

One limitation: cutter radius compensation does not fully model Appendix B corner joins and concavity checks, which can affect paths around compensated corners.
